notes.title: Post March Playtest Devblog – April Update & New Playtest
notes.notes:
🛠️ Post March Playtest Devblog – April Update & New Playtest

Greetings adventurers,

Following the March playtest, we've been hard at work improving every aspect of Mithrall based on your feedback. This update brings a massive wave of new features, UI overhauls, tool reworks, and gameplay polish.

We’re also thrilled to announce that the next playtest is happening this weekend — and this time, registrations are directly on Steam!


👉 Request Access on the Steam Page


[hr][/hr]

📚 Tech Tree Rework & UI Improvements


 Improved tooltip positioning  
 Tooltip now shows total crafting cost and required workbenches  
 Warnings added when missing prerequisite researches  
 Locked items now show costs and locked icon  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/7d4d1ec354c32a7b7bc6fac66a7772c7f3e44e58.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/daf2b8edde8844be9f143efb531a4bac827a1072.png

[hr][/hr]

🧠 Tutorial & Quest UI Improvements


 Tutorial window can now be minimized and expanded  
 Close button more visible  
 Two new tutorials:
  - Own your base (Influence Chest + Door)
  - Create a respawn point (Sleeping Bag)  
 Quest UI now displays XP rewards with better layout  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/28ab75baaa8d7880a7d2a7894103e64d24d862e5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/f87758dc7eafb5d8f9ce1df1b78f1d0e9a9af981.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/deae3f9ab73dd38b0d95f0abfa885c8d776550fb.png

[hr][/hr]

🧪 Crafting UI & System Changes


 Unknown items now appear as silhouettes in crafting queue  
 Primitive crafting queue includes new icons and border timer  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/433dc478b5ee22bab1ebd54fd3b86d4ede9af668.png

[hr][/hr]

🎯 Quality System Rebalance

The crafting quality system was completely reworked!

Previously, players reached Masterpiece quality too quickly. With the new system, the "quality band" progresses with skill level, making higher-tier results a meaningful achievement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/380c4c3127e0074916a4889c0ac29934a4e88e50.png

[hr][/hr]

💬 Context Menu System

We’ve added a brand new context menu in the chat UI!


 Mute  
 Report  
 Invite to Clan  
 Admin actions (for moderators)  


This system will soon expand across other game systems such as clan management and Influence Chests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292928/645901868d3385470685aecc85ed92b3a9bf48eb.png

[hr][/hr]

🧩 Puzzle Tools & Level Design Overhaul

We’ve added tons of tools to build dynamic puzzle gameplay and interactive dungeon logic:


 Player/enemy detection zones  
 Pressure plates with FX and trigger logic  
 Levers with sound, rotation, and reset behavior  
 Delay-based logic (e.g. delayed chests after puzzle solved)  
 Global FX spawner (visuals, sounds, particles)  
 Enhanced dungeon receptacles and interactive sequences

🎵 Keriathor’s Forest Music & Creature Sound Updates

We’ve implemented an introductory questline with rewards like:

 Bandages  
 XP  
 Knowledge Fragments  


PvP missions are now live — complete contracts such as:


“Bring back X dwarven ears from fallen enemies.”


[hr][/hr]

🛒 New Shop System & Mounts

Two exciting new systems:

🛍️ NPC Vendor Shops:  
Purchase basic gear and helpful supplies to get started faster.

🐎 Mounts are in!  
Players can now buy horses in the starting area and begin riding across Mithrall! This is just the beginning of the mount system — more types will come in future updates.

🐞 Bug Fixes & Improvements


 Bank items no longer vanish on reopen  
 Bank UI no longer shows other players’ inventories  
 Coin cost now applies when buying extra bank pages  
 Quest items with improper quality now fixed  
 Tablet fabricator interaction now works reliably  
 UI overlaps, tutorial triggers, and health bar display cleaned up  


[hr][/hr]

🎮 Playtest Starts This Weekend!

📅 Dates: Mai 2 (Friday) – Mai 4 (Sunday)  
⏰ Start Time: Friday at 6 PM CET


We’ve already passed 1000 signups — help us reach 2,000+ by sharing the playtest!


👉 Click here to register for the playtest

[hr][/hr]

Thank you for helping us shape this world — see you in Mithrall!  
— The Mithrall Dev Team 🛡️

notes.title: 🛠️ Mithrall Devblog – A Massive Update & Next Playtest !
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers! It’s been a long time since our last devblog, but that’s because we’ve been working hard behind the scenes to bring Mithrall to the next level. Today, we’re thrilled to share a massive update with new content, improved systems, fresh visuals, and, of course, details about the next playtest!

📅 Next Playtest Date:
🕒 Starts: March 28th (Evening)
🕒 Ends: March  30th (Evening)

If you haven’t registered yet, sign up here:
🌐 Register Now

Now, let’s dive into everything we’ve been working on!


🎓 New Tutorials – Learn to Survive! (Ulysse)
We’ve been working on new tutorial systems to make the game more accessible while still keeping the freedom that Mithrall is all about. New tutorial videos have been added to the game, covering:

✅ Movements
✅ Collecting Resources
✅ Primitive Crafting
✅ Active Crafting (Workbenches)
✅ Tailor Workbench
✅ Corpse Harvesting
✅ Combat

These tutorials will help newcomers get started while keeping the learning process immersive and engaging.

[previewyoutube=5dFqGRR1rzo;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=V70T1Mahdl4;full][/previewyoutube]


🎶 New Music & Soundscapes (Leo)
🔊 Etherion Highlands Theme

The maps are growing, and with them, new soundscapes to create an immersive experience. This new music composition has three distinct phases that build toward an emotional climax, blending:

🎻 Strings & Harp – To create a mystical feel
🎷 Wind Instruments – Such as clarinet & English horn for rich melodies
🎺 Brass – To intensify dramatic moments

🔊 Animals & Creatures Sounds

We’ve also overhauled the sound detection system for animals and creatures to make sure they’re easily recognizable in the world, no more straining your ears to hear distant threats!

🔨 Work in Progress:
✔️ Improved village ambiance for a livelier world
✔️ New emote sounds for better interactions
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/8aed38634103921f23e4b94d1ee38d24bc439840.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/3f9248c1572f6a4cbba3b2ba18d824b06626aaee.png
🎵 Listen to a sneak peek of the new music below!
[🎶 Music Preview 🎶]
[previewyoutube=5CSgmA9k3U8;full][/previewyoutube]

🏗️ New Character Rendering System (Julien)
Previously, our characters used multiple skinned mesh renderers, making performance heavy when many players were in one place.

Now, we’ve implemented UMA (Unity Multipurpose Avatar), which:
✅ Optimizes character performance – fewer draw calls, better FPS
✅ Reduces texture load – everything is now merged into one mesh

✨ New Character Models & Customization
🧝 New Dwarf Model!
👕 New Clothes & Armors! (Over 30 new outfits / armors)
⚙️ Customizable Body Features! (Early preview)
♀️ Female Character Option Added!
🛡️ First look at craftable armor!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/dda2dd7b845620e1c2f97754b1476085626da64e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/fc5a91e604de0121f658671943433e475c44d083.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/8a5b62889e31d5a5c5cf62e88642c4c66a58e034.png
[previewyoutube=AOsXkyMZSlM;full][/previewyoutube]

🌍 Level Design & New Zones (Magnus)
The world of Mithrall is expanding! We’ve created new areas, improving diversity in environments, from lush forests to open plains and dangerous enemy lairs.

📍New Zones (WIP)
🌲 Keriathor Forest – Mysterious woodland, home to hidden dangers
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a500fabfeb44b424d2534f5506711a5c4756342e.jpg
🌿 Esmerald Meadows – A dynamic area where players can build, trade, and fight
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a1c742f98e1c927829205121f145784048b2a39e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/18a5fcd5bd46b9eeac419a31a77b49033f46c403.jpg
🏔️ Etherion Highlands – Vast, open landscapes filled with secrets
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/d0e5cf37bb2a00729e1fd5cb859c88b0fca1a6bb.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/cb7c7793c093695aaee037a16ff1ae90176664fb.jpg

🔧 Improvements & Additions
🌳  20-30 new trees with custom colliders & harvestable data
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/b17e8a7c51bcb91e1913113ad6717ceb923cfd1c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/fec3bc14ad2a8846493e5497c150123a189fd6cb.jpg
🐉  20+ new enemy locations with unique encounters
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/f13354031452151bf46a1e2ce31bba81b7831935.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a1a23e1c64d40854e704ec1e570eadb7ca496ef1.jpg
💀  Introducing the ORCS!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/49835aea2317e9feca6d8140f5c1871dbd105666.jpg

⚔️ New Zone System – Green, Orange & Black Zones (Timothée)
To balance PvP, building, and exploration, we’ve reworked our zone system!

✅ Green Zones – Safe areas, no PvP, no building (towns, spawn points)
✅ Orange Zones – PvP optional (Bandits can attack, but will be marked hostile)
✅ Black Zones – Full PvP, open-world danger, build anywhere, Claim Territory

💡 New Features:
✔️ Dynamic Zones – Special areas that override server-wide rules
✔️ Green Safe Zones at Region Entrances – Prevents spawn camping
✔️ PvP Arenas in Green Zones – Controlled battle zones
✔️ Realm Tax System in Orange Zones – Auto-applied game tax in controlled areas
✔️ Optimized Map Loading – Load times reduced from 10 min (in some cases) to 1-2 min!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/4edae7247f24a4c84b064d43ddf4b347a893a598.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/4fcacc8bbe9a2afa3491437e2766987b5852d536.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/7bf9b1bd1e2c06d45df31d101e90f799a69b0bb6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/7179a466bd3e283f0e11b03ebc96c3e6c6610e7c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/8880d8c109abd80b35b0eb997679086b0e9a2f36.png

🍺 New Crafting Stations & Mounts (Jacob)
🏗️ New Structures:


 Brewing Station – Where dwarves brew legendary drinks! 🍻{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/0923869e9966154d0c59d82d7a9858aee6658368.png
 Cooking Stations – Each tier brings new possibilities 🍖
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/a113e9231ad266c7d3b809ab1b315d6a8be71d29.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/f8b2f3b6385cdf2bfb012f264a1e0f4f09322c1e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/600a29869801f15f6d9a46a8bcfe6aaf2f7ebdaf.png
 Stables – Raise and train animals 🐴
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/cdb5b990c27b3b012cebb99557f7ae75aea9e5f5.png
 Ancient Obelisks(Ancient tablette fabricator) – Mystical dwarven technology 🏛️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44939808/7bffe10ec7f73fe195d7699de29dbd245a4076dc.png

🏇 Mounts are here! Currently, there are two different mounts, but our goal is to make all wild creatures mountable in the future!

🛠 Side Note: Server Meshing Fixes & General Improvements
We’ve worked hard to fix a lot of issues with server meshing from the last playtest. Thanks to community feedback, we’ve been able to optimize performance, improve player synchronization, and make significant stability upgrades.

✅ Major bug fixes from the last playtest
✅ Server meshing is now much smoother
✅ Performance optimizations for large-scale battles & interactions

We look forward to testing these improvements in the next playtest and gathering your feedback!

🔥 Next Playtest Details & How to Join
The next playtest is scheduled for March  28th – 30th!

👥 We need more testers! Help us shape the game and stress-test our systems.
Register here:
🌐 www.mithrall.com

If you’ve already registered, you’re all set! Spread the word, invite your friends, and let’s make this the biggest test yet!

🚀 We’ll keep gathering feedback and improving Mithrall based on your input. See you in the next test!

- The Mithrall Dev Team

notes.title: Mithrall Devblog Update & Sneak Peeks
notes.notes:
⚒️ The Dwarven City. 

The development team has been hard at work on world-building, in-game mechanics, the main hall, characters, and so much more, while also keeping fans updated and answering your questions!

This peaceful, welcoming hub offers opportunities to trade with vendors, buy and sell items at the auction house, deposit money in the guild bank or personal bank, and meet other dwarves in the bustling meeting hall. You might even venture into the mines to uncover secrets within! And so much more!

Everything is still a work in progress, so if you have any suggestions or ideas, we’d love to hear them! Who knows—your ideas might even make it into the game!
